subject: POC signoff criteria, readout timing, and contract next steps
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@energytech.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@energytech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-14T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: POC scope, target metrics, and proposed timeline

Hi Aisha / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed path to keep momentum. Attaching a starter success-criteria spreadsheet and a draft mutual action plan.

High-level POC proposal (4 weeks)
- Goals: validate extraction accuracy on 5k historical docs + latency < 250ms p50 on typical queries
- Success criteria (provisional):
  • Extraction F1 >= 0.88 on sampled set
  • End-to-end 95th percentile latency < 600ms under a 5 rps sustained load
  • No PII leakage incidents in 1000 random prompts
- Ownership: EnergyTech to provide dataset and test harness (Tom / procurement), Redwood to provide model instance, KV caching, and weekly telemetry.
- Runbook & gating: weekly syncs, mid-POC checkpoint (day 14) to decide pivot/expand.

Immediate asks:
1) Please confirm the success criteria above or share edits (I attached the sheet so you can inline changes).
2) Confirm dataset delivery timeline (sample dataset by Mon 7/17?) and who will be the primary technical contact.
3) Exec readout: could we schedule a 30-min final readout with your CTO/VP Product the week of July 20? I propose 7/20 10:00am PT as a candidate slot.

Attachments: ET-POC-success-criteria.xlsx, mutual-action-plan-v2.docx

If that all looks good I’ll lock the mutual action plan and kick off the provisioning with infra.

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@energytech.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@energytech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-15T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: POC scope, target metrics, and proposed timeline

Connor —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick notes from our side after internal sync:
- The F1 bar is reasonable but can we make it ">= 0.85 on first pass" with a stretch goal of 0.90 after tuning? Our dataset has a few edge-case annotations.
- Add an operational metric: throughput target for peak bursts: 20 rps sustained for 30s without degradation in latency (we'll provide load pattern).
- Procurement (procurement@energytech.com) needs to review the mutual action plan — I’ve looped them in.

We can deliver a 1k-sample dataset by EOD 7/17 and the full test harness by 7/19. Primary tech contact will be Tom (copied).

Exec readout — 7/20 10:00am PT works for our CTO (she confirmed). Please include a 5–7 slide readout and a 10-min Q&A.

I attached a lightly edited success criteria file (see filename ET-POC-success-criteria.xlsx).

Best,
Aisha
Aisha Khan
Head of Integrations | EnergyTech Solutions
aisha.khan@energytech.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-16T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: prep for EnergyTech readout and contract handoff

Connor / Marissa —

Thanks — this looks good. A couple internal asks before we lock calendar:
- Sales Ops needs an SOW addendum template ready for procurement to sign after the readout. Marissa, can you draft that (one page, scope + acceptance criteria + price table)?
- We should agree on a decision rubric to make the exec readout clean. Proposal: pass/fail on each success criterion with weighted scoring (accuracy 50%, latency 20%, throughput 15%, security/compliance 15%).
- Include a rollback/fallback note in the run-of-show: if accuracy < 0.80 at mid-checkpoint, we propose a tuning window rather than immediate stop.
- Ops: confirm we can enable SSO test accounts (IdP SAML) — need the SAML metadata by 7/18.

I'll tentatively hold 7/20 10:00am PT on my calendar for the readout. Connor, can you push the meeting invite and request the CTO + VP Product attendance and procurement?

Laura Bennett
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@energytech.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@energytech.com>, Procurement <procurement@energytech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-18T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Confirming 7/20 readout + agenda and pre-reads

Aisha / Tom / Procurement —

Confirming the 7/20 10:00am PT readout with your CTO and VP Product. Agenda below (30 min total):
- 5m: introductions and goals (Connor)
- 10m: POC results summary + key telemetry (Laura)
- 10m: Risks, runbook, and recommended go/no-go (Marissa)
- 5m: Decision and next steps (EnergyTech execs)

Pre-reads attached: ET-POC-success-criteria.xlsx (finalized per Aisha), mutual-action-plan-v2.docx.

Two asks from us before the readout:
1) Please share the SAML metadata for SSO test accounts (or confirm it will be provided by 7/18).
2) Confirm who from your exec team will make the final decision — is it CTO alone or CTO + VP Product? This determines signoff process so Sales Ops can prepare the SOW addendum and DocuSign.

I’ll send the calendar invite with the readout link and include a placeholder DocuSign envelope for the SOW addendum so procurement can expedite review.

Thanks —
Connor

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@energytech.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@energytech.com>, Procurement <procurement@energytech.com>
Date: 2028-07-21T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confirming 7/20 readout + agenda and pre-reads

Connor / team —

Thanks for the clear agenda and materials. CTO and VP Product attended yesterday and we ran through the deck. Quick outcomes:
- The POC met the "pass" threshold on accuracy (0.86) and latency targets at our expected load patterns. Throughput burst handling needs one minor tweak but is within the acceptable contingency plan.
- Procurement will finalize T&Cs; they requested the one-page SOW addendum (Marissa, thanks in advance) and will route the DocuSign envelope to legal this morning.
- Decision process: CTO will present a recommendation and we expect a formal go/no-go by COB today 7/21. If any follow-up is needed we will ask for a short remediation window (48–72 hours).

Please share the DocuSign link and the SOW addendum when available. We appreciated Redwood's responsiveness — looking forward to the contract step.

Tom Alvarez
Director of Product Ops | EnergyTech Solutions
tom.alvarez@energytech.com
